source_typing: Sinha-Zahed fixes momenta and treats helicities at those momenta as qubits; the tested extension is a positive helicity-blind union of two momentum bins.
support_condition: Each nonnegative momentum-bin weight multiplies the identity on the helicity fiber and is independent of analyzer setting and outcome.
conclusion: Helicity-blind base support preserves normalized no-signalling and the Tsirelson bound under positive bin mixing. This supplies a canonical theoretical support class for the source packet, but not a loophole-free model of a real detector.
